name: P-003 recorded memory-source partition census before and after correction
rootCause: takeCandidateSnapshot ignored stored source_session and used per-fact IDs for calibration/test assignment.
detectorFailure: The first snapshot tests checked caller-supplied cluster strings; they never reconstructed two facts from one stored session.
comparisonProcedure: Read each frozen memory snapshot's IDs and assigned partitions; join IDs to memory_canonical. Group by COALESCE(payload->>'source_session',payload->'metadata'->>'source_session'), then count sources having two DISTINCT partitions. The same read evaluated both snapshots. V1 is preserved and prohibited as an independent-label input.
fix: candidateMemoryEntry records session:<source_session> clusters. Blind collection requires recorded provenance. --require-memory-source excludes unknown legacy provenance, preserving an explicit exclusion census and the full private source population.

guardTests.result: all three files pass; no scratch config

limitations: No retrieval model has been inferred on V2 yet. This source-split proof establishes the cohort boundary, not relevance quality.
The 1066 memories without recorded session provenance remain excluded from the independent-label population; no production memory data was changed.
